attchmntText: Krishana Phoschem Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Krishana Phoschem Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference Call with the National Stock Exchange. The call was held on November 18, 2026. The company reported Q2 FY27 revenue from operations of Rs. 703 crore, an increase of 16% year-on-year. EBITDA rose 74% to Rs. 127 crore with an 18% margin. Profit after tax increased 135% to Rs. 78 crore. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 2.52. For the half-year, revenue reached Rs. 1,235 crore, up 23%. H1 EBITDA was Rs. 216 crore, up 56%. H1 PAT was Rs. 125 crore, an all-time high. EPS was Rs. 4.04. Fertilizer production was 1,81,906 metric tonnes. Sales were 1,70,783 metric tonnes. The transcript is available on the company website.

voiceSummary: Krishana Phoschem Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference Call with the National Stock Exchange. The call was held on November 18, 2026. The company reported Q2 FY27 revenue from operations of Rs. 703 crore, an increase of 16% year-on-year. EBITDA rose 74% to Rs. 127 crore with an 18% margin. Profit after tax increased 135% to Rs. 78 crore. For the half-year, revenue reached Rs. 1,235 crore, up 23%. EBITDA was Rs. 216 crore, up 56%. Profit after tax hit an all-time high of Rs. 125 crore, up 96%. Fertilizer production stood at 1,81,906 metric tonnes. Sales were 1,70,783 metric tonnes. The company highlighted improved unit economics due to higher Nutrient Based Subsidy outlays for Rabi 2026-27. Management expects demand to continue during the Rabi season.

voiceSummary: Krishana Phoschem Limited informs the National Stock Exchange that the earnings conference call for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was held on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 12.00 Noon. The audio recording of this call is available on the company’s website at the link https://krishnaphoschem.com/financial-and-reports.html#webcast. This intimation is pursuant to Regulation 30 and 46 read with clause 15 of Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Regulations, 2015. The notice follows a previous intimation dated July 11th, 2026. The communication was signed by Anil Sharma, Company Secretary, with membership number A25045.
